registry_naming_2026_10_17.trust_boundary: A shipped LatinHypercube scan may resume from its own byte-verified checkpoint copy after the installed package path or bytes change. The local editable sampler_identity.json and scan copy are trusted project state; package-relative source recognition is compatibility evidence, not authentication against deliberate local forgery.

Unchanged HDF5 and CSV files are not rewritten; empty sealed shards may be removed
Changed shards are replaced atomically; interrupted cleanup is retryable without deleting final in-range rows
Archiver stop returns confirmation; supervisor checks liveness and exit code; forced/unclean exits skip trim, including retries
Teardown attempts summary, control lock, Workers and managed Redis despite errors; final errors propagate after cleanup; original scan exception takes priority
Replacement-scan plot generation follows successful stop and trim
Reserved names are enforced only at init, registry.load and check_plugin; generic metadata/loader validate structure and syntax

SDK CatalogExtension owns list/info parsing and rendering; HEP supplies catalog/report data only

HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION 2 identifies matching SDK source; public 1.0.3 lacks this interface and receives an actionable dependency diagnostic
Child Archiver drain/stop failure exits nonzero after closing its Redis connection
Retry validates CSV source digests even when HDF5 needs no further trim; empty live shards remove stale CSV/digest
public_interfaces: check_method_name is syntax-only; check_external_method_name enforces external registration policy
parse_metadata/load_plugin_file/load_plugin_source no longer accept trusted_builtin_method or reserved_names; loader has optional metadata_validator
